name: 時刻の書式と外部の説明を調整する利用設定
prompt:
Input roles: Image 1: authoritative Japanese mock: exact layout, spacing, scale and labels. Image 2: original source crop: radio control anatomy and divider treatment. Image 3: approved forest-green visual direction.
Use case: precise UI reconstruction. Reproduce the Japanese mock in Image 1 as closely as possible at exactly 390 x 284. Image 1 is the sole authority for layout, spacing, font scale, margins, line breaks, and the position of every element. Treat this as faithful recreation, not redesign; do not vertically compress or expand any section. Preserve the 16px horizontal inset, first heading at y=20, selected 12-hour option at y=59, 24-hour option at y=104, first divider at y=140, second heading at y=171, selected description at y=208, lower divider at y=244, footer at y=255. Image 2 is only a secondary guide for radio ring anatomy and thin dividers. Image 3 only confirms the approved white, forest-green, and slate palette. Copy exact strings and states from Image 1: 時刻の書式; 12時間表記（例：午後2:00）; 24時間表記（例：14:00）; ウェブ上の説明を表示; 空のメモと、自分のメモの下に表示; プライバシーの説明・お問い合わせ. Keep all text on one line where the mock does. No extra spaces in labels, icons, borders, shadows, phone chrome, or content. Output only a faithful clean rendering of Image 1.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
